name: athanor-codex
description: Codex-native companion skills for Athanor prompt generation, discuss, analyze, assessment, planning, work execution, LFG pipelines, release ceremony, CI watching, review, debugging, scope drift checks, verification, and setup diagnostics.

interface.longDescription: Athanor Codex brings the practical parts of Athanor to Codex: prompt generation and skill routing, discuss, analyze, goal-aligned assessment, implementation planning, work execution guidance, LFG and LFG-goal orchestration, release ceremony, CI watch and autofix guidance, structured review, triage-first debugging, scope drift checks, verify-before-completion discipline, and setup diagnostics. It is a companion plugin, not a port of Claude Code hooks or Task dispatch.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Athanor Codex to generate prompts, discuss, analyze, assess, plan, work, run LFG, release, watch CI, review, debug, verify, or scope-check this task.
